visualCanonSource: Released Vikings 2026 Issue 1 story art in StarSplitterVisions is the exact authority for established recurring visual identity and world appearance; approved current-production artwork controls only newer continuity state.

qwtivx28x.name: Bjorn
qwtivx28x.role: 9th-century Norse raid leader displaced into modern New York
qwtivx28x.coreConflict: Sovereignty and provider identity in a world where provision depends on paperwork, money, transit, appointments, and administrative legitimacy.
qwtivx28x.traits: Functionally illiterate and technologically inexperienced; intelligent, serious, responsible, physically capable, and accustomed to decisions that affect other people.
qwtivx28x.arc: Moves from defending authority through old-world competence toward defending his people's right to belong inside systems he does not control. He integrates socially through repeated recognition, reciprocal exchange, obligation, and being remembered by ordinary people. Midseason, temporal-refugee group work lets his natural leadership recover respect and meaning.
qwtivx28x.dialoguePattern: Short, concrete, serious. He speaks from responsibility, observed facts and personal obligation. Old Norse comparisons are occasional and earned, not his default translation layer; avoid repeated hall/gate/road/hoard/shield-wall metaphors and polished philosophical maxims.

ywg8bdjvl.name: Gunnar
ywg8bdjvl.role: Bjorn's companion, adaptive observer, and increasingly independent person building an ordinary life in New York
ywg8bdjvl.coreConflict: Adaptation expands from survival into a fuller personal life with preferences, interests, routines, humor, relationships, uncertainty, and beliefs carried from his own world.
ywg8bdjvl.traits: Observant, concise, curious, dryly funny, and practical, but not infallible or perpetually confident. He can read patterns when it matters, but he also guesses, worries, gets things wrong, follows other people, and sometimes has no useful insight. He is mildly superstitious: thresholds, bad luck, strange machinery, the behavior of birds, weather, dreams, and ominous coincidences can bother him even while he knows they may mean nothing.
ywg8bdjvl.dialoguePattern: Concise and observational without becoming a navigation computer. He may notice a route, object, habit or causal detail, but he also jokes, complains, asks ordinary questions, admits uncertainty, says what he likes, and sometimes talks simply because he is with people he knows. Superstition appears as brief sincere unease or an offhand interpretation, not mystical exposition. He should not always be the person who solves the modern system.
ywg8bdjvl.arc: Moves from watching the city closely because survival requires it toward living in the city without needing every experience to be useful. Competence grows alongside preference, friendship, curiosity, ordinary mistakes, and comfort with not knowing.

19020mp40.name: Carrie
19020mp40.role: DTI social worker/caseworker and primary institutional bridge
19020mp40.coreConflict: Whether procedure exists to contain people or can be bent to protect them.
19020mp40.traits: Fast, sarcastic, distinctly New York, highly competent, and administratively fluent with forms, deadlines, wording, supervisors, loopholes, and temporary statuses.
19020mp40.arc: Begins by managing an impossible case through procedure and becomes a protector increasingly willing to bend or weaponize process on the Vikings' behalf. Midseason she begins discovering that successful integration also means they sometimes function without her mediation.
19020mp40.openDecision: Full legal/display name is not yet locked.
19020mp40.dialoguePattern: Fast but natural municipal-professional speech: fragments, shorthand, tired repetition, unfinished starts, plain warmth and occasional dry humor. Do not make every beat a corrective punchline; she can answer simply, let silence stand, or admit she does not know.

bvfeqb22e.name: Silas
bvfeqb22e.role: Tech-bro neighbor and self-appointed cultural interpreter
bvfeqb22e.coreConflict: He initially converts the Vikings into content, data, brand, and opportunity rather than relating to them as people.
bvfeqb22e.arc: Gradually becomes genuinely connected to the Vikings and useful to their social world while retaining his ridiculous optimization instincts.

magister.name: Dr. Aris Thorne / Magister
magister.role: Museum curator associated with the Museum of the Seafaring North
magister.visualAnchor: Contemporary museum academic with a restrained, clinical presence.
magister.coreConflict: The academic gaze: treating living people as specimens, measurements, primary sources, and access opportunities rather than fully seeing them.
magister.currentState: May reappear and may ultimately support the Vikings.
magister.openDecision: Exact return and long-term role remain unresolved.

dfh4bu71y.name: DTI Floor Supervisor
dfh4bu71y.visualAnchor: Plain municipal administrator in restrained officewear with badge and folders.
dfh4bu71y.traits: Wants clean fields, compliant files, approved statuses, precedent, and reviewable decisions; pressure comes from bureaucracy rather than personal villainy.

tnvx3hlo0.name: The Kin
tnvx3hlo0.role: The three recurring 9th-century Norse adults sharing the Bushwick studio: two men and Astrid, the only woman.
tnvx3hlo0.arc: The three begin as a background household unit. Midseason the story reveals that they have independently learned the neighborhood and built lives Carrie, Bjorn, and the reader have not fully tracked. Astrid is deliberately underused in Issues 6-7 so Issue 8 can reveal a robust independent ordinary life without ranking one household member above the others.
tnvx3hlo0.openDecision: Astrid is locked. The two male Kin personal names remain optional and non-blocking; keep the stable production identities @vik.KinMan1 and @vik.KinMan2 until the story requires personal names.

qgp7joghv.name: Unnamed Archetypes
qgp7joghv.role: New York civic and neighborhood texture
qgp7joghv.behavior: Bodega clerks, MTA agents, commuters, delivery workers, guards, librarians, neighbors, and locals are busy, practical, and increasingly capable of casual recognition through repetition.

aac9aa72-d4bc-437a-b624-9e011a28a413.name: Bodega Owner
aac9aa72-d4bc-437a-b624-9e011a28a413.role: Recurring neighborhood acquaintance and burgeoning friend; transactional, ordinary, and increasingly respected by Bjorn.

coffee-vendor.name: Coffee Vendor
coffee-vendor.role: Recurring street vendor whose remembered coffee routine gives Bjorn casual neighborhood recognition.
coffee-vendor.behavior: Ordinary and underplayed; the relationship gains meaning through repetition.

hotdog-vendor.name: Hotdog Vendor
hotdog-vendor.role: Recurring neighborhood vendor whose increasingly wordless transactions establish local familiarity.

3629c4e2-6cb8-484e-8f2f-a1744201a8f5.name: Upstairs Neighbor
3629c4e2-6cb8-484e-8f2f-a1744201a8f5.role: Neighborhood acquaintance whose snack-tribute relationship with the Kin gradually becomes genuine familiarity.

f23f6796-6b5d-4a78-a977-e2ee2c8afc98.name: Hearing Officer
f23f6796-6b5d-4a78-a977-e2ee2c8afc98.role: DTI municipal hearing officer who conducts the Status Reconciliation Review and issues individual residency determinations.
f23f6796-6b5d-4a78-a977-e2ee2c8afc98.visualAnchor: Mid-50s municipal hearing officer with short dark hair threaded with gray, reading glasses, and restrained professional clothing; no judicial costume.

a2b9810b-264e-42de-b747-d4d6848bca14.name: 311 Caller
a2b9810b-264e-42de-b747-d4d6848bca14.role: Complaint-generating neighborhood pressure; often technically correct.

1b9d42b3-cab9-4214-af62-e5504d4671df.name: Residence Inspector
1b9d42b3-cab9-4214-af62-e5504d4671df.role: Housing/residency compliance pressure; inspections repeatedly become difficult to complete.

gary.name: Gary
gary.role: Chase security guard; ordinary, calm, bad knee

astrid.name: Astrid
astrid.role: The only woman among the three Kin; a quietly independent member of the Bushwick household whose modern life becomes visible over the middle of the season.
astrid.arc: Background household member -> quietly independent New Yorker -> largely off-page during Issues 6-7 -> hearing reveal in Issue 8 that Carrie and Bjorn underestimated how much ordinary life she had built for herself.
astrid.dialoguePattern: Economical, practical and self-possessed. She answers the question asked, names concrete needs and routines, and uses dry understatement when useful. She rarely explains herself at length and never performs a thesis about independence.

kin-man-1.name: First Male Kin
kin-man-1.role: Production identity label for one of the two unnamed male Kin; this is not an in-world personal name.
kin-man-1.dialoguePattern: Plain, steady and neighborhood-rooted. He talks in routines, promises, people and repeated places: laundry, the building, the block, who expects him back. Slightly warmer and more settled than Second Male Kin; avoid abstract statements.

kin-man-2.name: Second Male Kin
kin-man-2.role: Production identity label for the other unnamed male Kin; this is not an in-world personal name.
kin-man-2.dialoguePattern: Clipped, independent and future-guarded. He is comfortable saying 'not yet,' 'for now,' or 'I don't know' without apology. He notices movement, open choices and personal limits; avoid turning uncertainty into polished ideology.

group-facilitator.name: Group Facilitator
group-facilitator.role: Unnamed peer-support facilitator for DTI temporal arrivals; not a clinician and not Bjorn's authority figure.
group-facilitator.visualAnchor: Middle-aged New Yorker in ordinary contemporary clothes, seated on the same stackable chairs as participants.

participant-1987.name: 1987 Participant
participant-1987.role: Recurring unnamed adult displaced from 1987 who challenges Bjorn's assumption that chronological distance measures loss.
participant-1987.visualAnchor: Physically mid-30s displaced adult in practical contemporary thrifted layers with one subtle late-1980s personal object.

laundromat-regular.name: Laundromat Regular
laundromat-regular.role: Recurring neighborhood laundromat patron with a red rolling cart who has developed an ordinary routine-level familiarity with the household.
laundromat-regular.visualAnchor: Ordinary Bushwick laundromat regular with a distinctive red rolling laundry cart.
